provenance.noteProvenance: RECONSTRUCTED. tests/scenarios.mjs carries this scenario with no `note` field, but its quotes ('unexplained wt loss 5.5% over past 6/12', 'wt loss 5.5%') can only come from RP-001's note with 5% replaced by 5.5%. That substitution is the note recorded here. It is the only case in this seed whose note text was not taken from the matrix, and it must be labelled as synthetic in any benchmark score - it measures the engine's threshold boundary, not a model's reading of a real referral.
provenance.divergence: None: this variant exists to show what changes when the weight-loss threshold is crossed. workup.bloods is answered `inferred`, so under the strict standard it does not establish criterion A and still appears in missingInformation - the visible mechanism of AD-04 / KI-04.
